groups.problem: Caching a device before successful admission lets rejected devices bypass the limit on subsequent requests.
groups.rationale: All three describe the same premature cache entry and resulting authentication bypass. They point to error propagation or authentication, but fixing when admission is cached resolves all three.

groups.problem: The non-atomic count check and device insertion allow concurrent admissions to exceed the configured limit.
groups.rationale: All three report the same race in CreateOrUpdateDevice, including across instances, and require atomic coordination of capacity checking and insertion.
